note: Janssen et al. (2022) assesses cranial phenotypes including microcephaly (HP:0000252) across individuals with TAF4 variants and TFIID-related disorders, supporting directional cranial growth restriction rather than macrocephaly.

evidence.text: Janssen et al. (2022) describe eight individuals with de novo putative loss-of-function variants in TAF4 presenting with a neurodevelopmental disorder, and itemize features including Microcephaly (HP:0000252) in Table 1.

source.title: De novo putative loss‐of‐function variants in TAF4 are associated with a neuro‐developmental disorder
source.quote: We here present a cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neuro-developmental disorder (NDD).
